reviewContext: President-authorized compilation of basin-boundary sensitivity into a deterministic adaptive evidence/computation budget: sampled Newton-basin boundary proximity, convergence residual and iteration strain increase only local counterfactual twins, proof samples and materialization resolution; deep well-separated converged regions may keep unrelated derived detail folded; uncertain/nonconverged basin evidence fails closed and never authorizes aggressive folding; machine kernel and ship self-development compiler now know this rule without AI rediscovery
reviewedSemantics: Adaptive Evidence Budget is an allocation law over already-sampled attractor-basin diagnostics, not a claim that finite Newton sampling proves an exact fractal basin boundary or global stability

the v1 criticality score is the maximum of sampled boundary proximity 1/(1+d_sample/d_ref), bounded residual strain and bounded iteration strain, so any observed sensitivity can increase the local evidence budget
the budget multiplier is 1+criticality*(maxMultiplier-1) and deterministically scales local counterfactual twin count, proof sample count and local resolution while preserving declared base budgets
nearer sampled different-attractor regions therefore receive more local evidence/computation than deep well-separated regions under the same budget contract

deep-basin folding is conservative: only converged states with numeric sampled boundary distance, residual and iteration evidence may derive a foldUnrelatedDetail hint under a declared threshold; no canonical cause is deleted by this primitive
nonconverged, missing or malformed basin evidence returns REVIEW_REQUIRED, uses the maximum declared safe local budget suggestion and explicitly forbids aggressive folding
sampledBoundaryDistanceEstimate remains sampledOnly=true, exactBoundaryProven=false and globalStabilityProven=false; the new allocator cannot upgrade approximate basin evidence into exact proof

the machine kernel maps BASIN_BOUNDARY_SENSITIVITY to increased local counterfactual resolution and DEEP_BASIN_STABILITY to keeping unrelated derived detail folded within a declared threshold
